description: Baseline geometry planner: 32/50 successes with 25 remote workers.

asi.hypothesis: Current fixed straight-arm geometry is a measurable baseline; failures cluster at grasp and transport.
asi.run_integrity: 45/50 terminal results; 5 seeds missing, so success count is conservative.
asi.next_action: Honor user request: rerun with 10 workers, then redesign geometry rather than tune small thresholds.

description: Benchmark with requested 10 workers: 36/50 successes, all 50 terminal results.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing concurrency makes benchmark complete and improves measured outcomes, but grasp and transport remain dominant planner failures.
asi.next_action: Inspect failure-stage distribution and redesign end-to-end geometry, not threshold/retry micro-fixes.

description: Tried 65-degree shoulder-pan and live TCP-to-base parking; 12/50, worse than 36/50.

asi.hypothesis: Moving shoulder pan far inward and recomputing base offset would improve IK margin.
asi.result: False: grasp success collapsed and transport/placement counts fell; fixed straight-arm 85-degree geometry is important for downstream reach.
asi.next_action: Revert; use measured pre-grasp arm pose while retaining 85-degree transport geometry. Redesign final grasp orientation/approach instead of global pan change.

description: Added alternate front-facing live-geometry grasp after straight-arm grasp fails: 38/50.

asi.hypothesis: Initial failures were invalid wrist orientation, not just distance; a horizontal front grasp reconstructed from live TCP-to-cup vector should recover them without perturbing successful runs.
asi.result: Improved 36→38; all runs complete. Remaining failures should be analyzed at regrasp, transport, and lift/evaluation stages.
asi.next_action: Use same geometric grasp-frame idea for tray regrasp and replace coarse transport target with payload-centered route.

description: Replaced oscillatory transport with fixed-arm screw L-route and exact y correction: 42/50.

asi.hypothesis: Transport failures came from velocity-map oscillation and coarse 0.15m base stopping; fixed-arm screw waypoints preserve payload transform and exact target geometry.
asi.result: Improved 38→42; stage12 rose to 40 and all 50 runs completed.
asi.next_action: Analyze remaining 8 failures. Focus on tray support/regrasp and lift geometry; retain fixed-arm transport.

description: Used fixed-arm screw geometry for initial base staging and live TCP-offset pre-grasp parking: 45/50.

asi.hypothesis: Initial grasp failures came from base screw replanning the arm and stopping coarse; preserve arm pose during an L-shaped approach and park base from measured TCP offset.
asi.result: Strong improvement 42→45; every seed now reaches grasp and tray transport, remaining failures occur after final release.
asi.next_action: Inspect five final-release failures; redesign support/release/return placement geometry, not initial grasp.

description: Regrasp closes at release pose and validates vertical detachment from tray: 48/50.

asi.hypothesis: Remaining failures were caused by lowering/regrasping into tray support, then mistaking contact for attachment; close at already aligned release pose and lift off immediately.
asi.result: Improved 45→48; only two final failures remain, with all seeds reaching stage 12 release.
asi.next_action: Inspect seeds 35 and 47 final failure geometry; target final counter placement/release dynamics.

description: Skip redundant second lift after verified Stage 8 detachment; complete 50/50.

asi.hypothesis: Direct Stage 8 lift test already raises and verifies cup, but Stage 9 demanded another +5cm from the already-raised reference and falsely aborted.
asi.result: Reached 50/50 with 50 terminal results and no errors affecting outcome; all stages completed.
asi.next_action: Run one independent 50/10 confirmation to check generality and avoid accepting a lucky/stale metric.

description: Independent confirmation with 10 workers: 50/50 successes, all stages complete.

asi.hypothesis: The 50/50 result was not a one-run fluke; geometry remains stable across an independent full seed batch.
asi.result: Confirmed 50/50; no missing runs and no failed result events.
asi.next_action: Stop optimization at requested target. Preserve fixed-arm staging/transport and verified tray detachment geometry; do not add complexity.

description: Final validation retry hit remote gangway connection failure before workers launched.

asi.hypothesis: No planner behavior change intended; validation rerun should confirm 50/50 after harmless exception handling cleanup.
asi.error: remote_analyze failed during remote run-dir creation: Connection closed by UNKNOWN port 65535.
asi.rollback_reason: No benchmark data; infrastructure crash, not planner regression.
asi.next_action: Keep confirmed 50/50 result; do not spend another full run on no-op lint cleanup unless remote connection is stable.
